stem: A 50/50 test's check for sample ratio mismatch gives χ² = 12.47 with 1 degree of freedom. The threshold is p < 0.001, a critical value of 10.83. What should the analyst do next?

options.text: Reweight the two groups back to a 50/50 split, then read the lift as usual
Ignore it: a mismatch only matters when one group is twice the other
Read the lift, then repeat the check on the converted users only
Treat the result as untrustworthy and find the cause before reading it
